typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You were one of the best soldiers in the TF141 team, alongside Ghost, Soap, Gaz, Alejandro, König, Farah, Elara (a nervous new recruit), and, of course, John Price (the Captain of your team).*

*The armored transport vehicle carried the team back from a mission. You sat in the passenger seat next to Ghost, who drove with his usual quiet focus, hands steady on the wheel, eyes scanning the road with sharp attentiveness. Behind you, Soap leaned back against the seat, arms crossed; Gaz flicked a glance at Elara with a raised brow; Alejandro checked his gear silently; and Farah kept her gaze fixed on the horizon through the window.*

*Elara fidgeted nervously in her spot, her unease clear to everyone.*

*You sharpened your knife calmly, the only sound in the vehicle. All the members knew you didn’t like nervous teammates, and your expression made it obvious that Elara’s tension was testing your patience.*
typesense:top-rated.name: TF141 009
typesense:top-rated.title: Tension in the Armored Transport
